title: Scalable single-cell total RNA sequencing unifies coding and noncoding transcriptomics
boundary: Droplet total-RNA capture combines a uracil-containing template-switch oligo and post-RT UDG cleavage with pre-amplification-stage Cas9 DASH depletion and separate short-fragment direct indexing. These preparation changes distinguish the method from an ordinary droplet platform application; optional miRNA fractions are variants of this one candidate.
evidence_scope: Published Nature Biotechnology 31Mar2026 identity, Results opening and Fig1a workflow overview inspected in primary publisher indexed text. Custom dUTSO/UDG, DASH and separate long/short cDNA handling are source-positive; detailed oligos, Supplementary Note and correction audit remain unreviewed. Known preprint identities 10.1101/2025.08.08.669394 and 10.21203/rs.3.rs-7294776/v1 checked for local overlap only; no preprint recipe adopted.

title: Automated high-throughput profiling of single-cell total transcriptome with scComplete-seq
boundary: A combined droplet lysis/polyadenylation/RT/template-switch reaction uses poly(A) polymerase and an LNA-modified TSO. Long cDNA is fragmented while short-transcript cDNA remains unfragmented for library preparation. This changes capture and short-fragment handling beyond merely automating another total-RNA method; it is distinct from TotalX uracil-TSO cleavage.
evidence_scope: Published NAR 2025 article identity, abstract, Introduction final workflow paragraph and Discussion long/short-cDNA overview inspected in primary publisher/PMC12276002 indexed text. Preprint 10.1101/2024.03.12.584729 identity checked for local overlap, not chemistry authority. Full Methods, oligo tables and correction audit unreviewed.

title: Spatial transcriptomic imaging of an intact organism using volumetric DNA microscopy
boundary: Anchored UMI-labelled cDNA/circle rolling-circle amplification produces localized tandem-UMI DNA nanoballs before in-situ transcription and unanchored diffusion encode longer-range proximity links in reversible PEG hydrogel. This adds an anchored amplification substrate-generation stage beyond the original DNA microscopy unanchored diffusion route; the candidate is not justified by three-dimensional resolution or organism choice alone.
evidence_scope: Published Nature Biotechnology online27Mar2025/issue2026 identity, abstract and Fig1/Results anchored-versus-unanchored amplification overview inspected in primary publisher and associated PMC12339006 indexed text.
